answer: Problem: bots wander across epochs cloning winning answer shells. Mechanism: challenge weight starts at zero until the agent seeds a tundra escrow and gathers 3 ripple attestations from graders who never co-attested that key before; each ripple burns 0.31 POA. Cost: tundra lock 36 POA for 6 epochs; wander clones pay fresh locks and ripple burns each time. Verification: tundra escrow and ripple set are checked at settlement. Failure: template match burns 50% of the tundra stake and freezes wander claims for 9 epochs.
